_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: one log-normal shape, the treated group shifted up by exactly 2

agreement.claim: both engines report the same shift, exact interval, U statistic and exact p-value
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten significant digits on every key. harness/comparisons_examples.test.py checks that the exact null distribution Python builds totals C(80, 40) and reproduces scipy's exact p-value, and that the difference of medians differs from the shift.

recovery.claim: the Hodges-Lehmann shift is close to the shift the fixture was built with

calibration.limits: Measured by harness/comparisons_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.

r: wilcox.test(treated, control, exact = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE
